slots.original: Goal: consistent wake time, 7:00 daily incl. weekends. Caffeine cutoff 2 pm. Screens off 30 minutes pre-bed — light exposure suppression of melatonin onset is the key lever here. Can't sleep after 20 min? Get up, low-light activity, retry. Morning sunlight 10 minutes → circadian anchor reinforcement. Expect 1–2 weeks adjustment.

rtt_slots: Goal: Wake up consistently at 7 a.m. every day, including weekends. Limit caffeine intake to before 2 p.m. Turn off screens 30 minutes before bedtime—the key here is to reduce the effects of light that interfere with melatonin secretion. If you can’t fall asleep for more than 20 minutes, get up and engage in activities in a dimly lit environment, then try again. Exposing yourself to morning sunlight for 10 minutes helps strengthen your body’s internal clock rhythm. It is estimated that it will take 1–2 weeks to adjust.
